# Accounts and repositories {#accounts}

*Due with HW1. Capstone this week: 5 whys and gap analysis; research question.*

## GitHub

Make three repositories:

1. **Portfolio:** open the [portfolio template](https://github.com/alexandragrayson/datatrail-portfolio-template), click **Use this template → Create a new repository**, and name it `<username>.github.io` using your exact GitHub username. Here's [what your site will look like](https://alexandragrayson.github.io/datatrail-portfolio-template/).
2. **Blog:** name it `blog`.
3. **Capstone:** name it `capstone` for now.

Then [personalize your GitHub profile](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/tutorials/personalize-your-profile).

## Kaggle

Start with [The Beginner's Guide to Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/discussions/getting-started/134162). Some competitions to try:

- [Digit Recognizer](https://www.kaggle.com/c/digit-recognizer), an essential computer vision problem if that interests you
- [Titanic: Machine Learning from Disaster](https://www.kaggle.com/c/titanic)
- [Spaceship Titanic](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/spaceship-titanic)
- [House Prices: Advanced Regression Techniques](https://www.kaggle.com/c/house-prices-advanced-regression-techniques)
- [Store Sales: Time Series Forecasting](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/store-sales-time-series-forecasting)
- [Contradictory, My Dear Watson](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/contradictory-my-dear-watson)
- [Natural Language Processing with Disaster Tweets](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/nlp-getting-started)
